title: heracleum sphondylium subsp. trachycarpum
intro: Heracleum sphondylium subsp. trachycarpum, commonly known as wild celery, is a subspecies of the greater celery plant, belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of wild celery include stimulating digestion, reducing inflammation, and exerting a sedative effect on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents present in wild celery include essential oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
